title: fix(app-shell): New package dialog drops the retired "project-scoped" wording
body:
Fixes #13126
Clause-②: no

## What

Studio's New package dialog described the package as "project-scoped" (zh 创建项目范围的软件包), a scope word ObjectStack retired when it renamed project to environment (ObjectStack ADR-0006). The dialog is not environment-scoped either (create sends no `scope`; the server defaults it, objectui#12869), so per the dispatch ruling the sentence now carries no scope word:

- en: "Create a writable package to author and publish your own metadata. The id should be reverse-domain (e.g. {example})."
- zh: "创建可写的软件包，用来编写和发布你自己的元数据。ID 建议使用反向域名格式（例如 {example}）。"

Only the `engine.packages.create.description` row changes (the table carries en and zh only). No existing pin asserted the old sentence, so no pin was updated.

## Files

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (the one row, en + zh)
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.createCopy-13126.test.tsx` (new pin)
- `.changeset/13126-package-dialog-copy.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch)

## Pin and ablation

The new test renders the dialog in create mode in en-US and zh-CN, reads the description through the dialog's `aria-describedby` link (positive control: the interpolated `com.acme.crm` is present), and asserts it does not match `/project/i` (zh: also not `项目`).

Ablation via `objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, landed on disk), one leg per locale, at commit 0d9f30f2e1:

- en leg: old en sentence put back: `× carries no "project" scope word in English`, `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, exit 1.
- zh leg: old zh sentence put back: `× carries no 项目 scope word in Chinese`, `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, exit 1.
- Restore proven by blob hash after each leg: `i18n.ts` = `c151bc60479f1e3ad5f4256aa2cb763e220de545` = the HEAD blob; `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Local verification (at 0d9f30f2e1)

- Closure build `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 (`tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test file, counted with `--listFiles`).
- New test: 2/2 passed. Touched-file family (all `PackageFormDialog.*`, `PackagesPage*` and metadata-admin `*i18n*` tests, 26 files): 223/223 passed.
- eslint narrowed to the 2 changed source files (root `eslint.config.js`, no type-aware linting, so the diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict): 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Pre-tsc battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/app-shell/` vitest directory (not run locally, per the dispatch's shared-lock rule).

## Acceptance notes

Other rows in the same table that contain "project", left as they are:

- `engine.packages.scope.project` (en "Read-only · code", zh 只读 · 代码包): only the key names the `project` wire value of `ManifestSchema.scope`; the shown text has no scope word.
- zh `engine.packages.form.help.scope` (部署范围：cloud（云端）、system（系统）、project（项目）): names the literal `scope` enum value the spec still carries; it is drawn only in edit/view mode (create has no scope row), so it is not this sentence. Whether the gloss 项目 should change follows whatever the spec does with the enum value.
- zh `engine.packages.form.help.namespace`: `todo_project` is an example object name, not the retired term.
